title: The Modern Gastronomic Revolution and Artisan Winemaking
grammar: Integration of resultative sublatives and sensory similes in culinary critique
goal: I can analyze the 21st-century Hungarian gastronomic revolution, Michelin stars, and artisan winemaking.
I can combine resultative sublatives and sensory similes in complex culinary reviews and descriptions.
I can discuss local terroir, indigenous grape varieties (Furmint, Kadarka, Kékfrankos), and farm-to-table ethics.
